messages:
amy_support: FYI — escalated from AcmeAI. They say invoice INV-2026-348 shows ~18,200 embedding units for last week but their dashboard (and our UI) shows ~3,640. They used bulk embeddings + rerank in one job. Customer pasted a request ID: req_0a1b2c and says some vectors look like zeros in their export. Ticket attached (I linked the ticket).

jake_billing: Can you drop invoice id, customer account id, and a sample of the raw request payload they sent? Also request the billing CSV export for that invoice (we need the per-line metering rows).

amy_support: Account: acct-acmeai-01. Invoice INV-2026-348. They attached the payload they sent; pasting sanitized snippet here:```json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-2",
  "batch": ["long text A...", "long text B...", "" /* empty string observed */, "long text N..."],
  "mode": "pairwise_rerank",
  "batch_size": 500,
  "top_k": 10
}
```They said they streamed 3 separate upload chunks in the same job and client retried a failed chunk once.

sara_eng_ml: Quick hypothesis: two likely contributors — (1) pairwise rerank metering counts differ from per-input embed counts (pairwise should count pairs) and (2) batch-splitting + retries may have double-charged. We had a prior regression where split+retry didn't dedupe meter records when the idempotency-key was missing.

mike_oncall: I pulled the ingestion traces for req_0a1b2c. We have batch_split events:```
[2026-02-18T14:22:08Z] ingest service request=req_0a1b2c batch_size=500 split_to=3
[2026-02-18T14:22:09Z] charging service request=req_0a1b2c chunk=1 units=6000
[2026-02-18T14:22:09Z] charging service request=req_0a1b2c chunk=2 units=6000 retry=1
[2026-02-18T14:22:09Z] charging service request=req_0a1b2c chunk=3 units=6000
```That looks like three chunks x 6k = 18k units. The dashboard query used to generate the UI rollup seems to be filtering out retry-tagged rows, which explains the ~3.6k visible (that was only chunk 1).

amy_support: So the dashboard is under-reporting because it excludes retry rows? Customer is seeing invoice with all charge rows and thinks we're overcharging. We should confirm whether retries are legitimately billable (depends on idempotency).

jake_billing: Historically we bill retries if the upstream client did not provide an idempotency key and the request actually executed twice. If the retry replayed the chunk, it is chargeable. But we should avoid double-charges when the orchestrator replays due to internal transient errors — that's a product decision. For now we can offer a partial credit while we investigate. I'll open a billing ticket and request the raw CSV lines for INV-2026-348.

sara_eng_ml: Additional thing: the customer said some vectors show as near-zero. I inspected the model logs and found ~7 inputs that were empty strings after client pre-processing. Our vector service emits zero vectors for empty inputs and we *do* meter those as an attempt. But if the dashboard UI filters out empty-input rows earlier in the pipeline, that could also cause a mismatch. We should reproduce with a replay.

amy_support: Can someone paste a minimal curl/python reproduction I can send back to Acme so they can reproduce locally? They asked for steps to make sure the client isn't accidentally re-sending chunks.

sara_eng_ml: Paste this (replay instructions):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: replay-req-0a1b2c" \ \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2","mode":"pairwise_rerank","batch":["text1","","text3", /* ... */],"batch_size":500}'
```
Note: add Idempotency-Key for each top-level job. Also ask them to log client retry behavior (timestamps + http status).

mike_oncall: I'll run a staging replay with that idempotency key and the exact chunk boundaries we saw. I'll enable granular metering debug so we can see per-chunk and per-retry rows.

jake_billing: For remediation: (1) open refund request for duplicated retry rows if they were caused by client replays vs internal replays, (2) require Idempotency-Key on bulk rerank API and reject non-idempotent retries unless explicit, (3) add a dashboard column to show "charged rows (incl retries)" so customers see parity with invoice. I'll file a product/billing follow-up.

amy_support: I'll file BT-4721 (billing) and attach logs + the replay curl. I'll also ping the customer with suggested repro steps and offer to run the staging replay with them. Will update ticket when we have staging results. :eyes:
